Multi-aggregate commits ride one `commitExpectedVersionDecisionLegs` (see apps/daemon/src/planning/graph-activation-service.ts:41).
- The goal's run: the durable goal state carries ONE immutable `planningRunRef` (read at apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts:88); `planReviewable(ledger, runId)` (:78-81) keys on the run lifecycle. Nothing today follows a REJECTED run to its successor.
- Activity: apps/daemon/src/http/activity-read.ts:77 VERDICT_KINDS = {escalation.decide, review.submit}; `verdictOf(commandKind, resultBytes)` (:80) reads the committed result; apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/activity-words.ts:69 ALREADY renders "approved the plan" / "rejected the plan" for an approval verdict - the server never emits one.

An empty/whitespace reason refuses APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED (layer DAEMON_PREREQUISITE) before any durable read; a run not in PLAN_REVIEW refuses with the existing sources/lifecycle code. (2) `currentPlanningRun(ledger, goal)` in a new module apps/daemon/src/planning/current-planning-run.ts (+.js): starts at goal.planningRunRef and follows lifecycle REJECTED -> successorRunId (bounded to 16 hops, cycle-safe, unreadable -> the original ref) returning {runId, hops, rejected: [{runId, successorRunId}]}. (3) activity-read.ts VERDICT_KINDS gains approval.decide_intent (and approval.decide) reading `result.decision`.
